runtime: Tauri debug --no-bundle (vite production frontend), WebKitGTK 2.54.1, X11 Xvfb 1280x1024x24 default DPI (DPR 1.042), software rendering (LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1, WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1), dbus-run-session per run (gates/final perf); e2e smoke Xvfb -dpi 96
perfProtocol: zoom 50%, warm-up 3 groups (Right+'ab'), 30 groups Right+'a'(groupStart)+'b'(extend), Undo/Redo 20 pairs, 5 Undo+type; native X11 xdotool keys; one app session per document
timingContract: unchanged: keydown timestamp -> local revision observed in RAF -> two more RAFs (presentation upper bound, not hardware presentation time). Attribution timestamps (input, handlerEnd, observed, raf1) are recorded separately and never replace keyToFrame.
zeroWorkFrameFloor: same 3-RAF chain from a timer task with no input/model work, 30 samples; measured right after the typing loop, so on multi-page documents it includes deferred offscreen rendering (not idle)
busyProbe: diagnostic-only runs (perf-diagnostic-busy-probe.json) perturb scheduling and are excluded from gate values
loadNote: an unrelated process of another workspace ran concurrently during part of the session; /proc/loadavg at final perf start 1.29-2.74
